title: Fix Bill settled garbled text and font flash
summary: Corrupted Unicode (arrow/dash) from file restore showed as fA etc. Receipt fonts now match system stack immediately so Inter/monospace no longer swaps after a second. Cleaner date/time on receipt.
highlights: Fixed Open Gateway and bill synced text encoding
Receipt uses system-ui + Georgia (no late web-font swap)
Readable local date/time instead of raw ISO
Deferred PDF warm to avoid jank on open
